notes.title: v0.8.0 - Grab & Throw Madness
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35484557/7203c0343123e19cae81ab693de673cb26a5be05.jpg[/img]
Grab & Throw Madness
Greatest changes in Balance Breakers, a new general move: Grab & Throw.
Give your friend a hug, then throw them far away!


[b]version 0.8.0
release date: 20/08/2021[/b]


[b]Gameplay[/b]
Try our the brand new gameplay experience with the new Grab & Throw move!

[b]Grab & Throw[/b]
Punch is now changed as a two-step move: Grab & Throw.
[list][*]First cast will lunge forward a short distance and pick up objects or characters in the front, don't miss it and fall over.
[*]Second cast will throw the object or character forward, aim to score the goal!
[/list]

[b]Arena and Maps[/b]
With Grab & Throw's launch, several items and map are changed for better experience. 

[list][b]Team Battle[/b]
[*]Team Battle are now playing with 3 minutes, take your time to win with the new pace. 
[*]Bosses are now always aim the character carrying most coins.
[*]Boss attacks will no longer damage the ship.
[/list]
[list][b]Echo Valley[/b]
[*]Bat-T's ultimate is now coming two by two, slowing down the speed for player to dodge.
[/list]
[list][b]Plasma Cavern[/b]
[*]Plasma Magma's hit box is fixed, just walk over the magma and it won't hurt you.
[/list]

[b]Items and Special Coins[/b]
New items playing around with Grab & Throw are added.
Existing Special Coins are adjusted to make the game more clear.

[b]Grab & Throw Items[/b]
[list][b]Golden Orb[/b]
[*]Throw it to base and gain 20 coins.
[b]Evil Orb[/b]
[*]Throw it to base and hit 20% coins out.
[b]Trash[/b]
[*]Throw it to base and hit 1 coin out.
[/list]

[b]Special Coins[/b]
Each special coins are unique in the battle ground, they will be spawned after the previous one is gone.
[list][b]Rainbow Coin[/b]
[*]Rainbow Coin will continuously spawn 21 coins once triggered.
[/list]
[list][b]Darkness Coin[/b]
[*]Darkness Coin will spawn a portal, character step on the portal will be knocked up by the darkness spike and drop half of the coin collected.
[/list]


[b]Breakers Adjustment[/b]
Balance over Breakers are needed in the new environment.
All Damage are based on percentage in stead of fixed number.

[b]Magi Maru Maru[/b]
[list][b]Bubble Dash[/b]
[*]Bubbles with characters trapped inside can be hit away.
[/list]

[b]Black[/b]
[list][b]Case Monster[/b] 
[*]Case Monster will automatically collect coins and grow bigger.
[*]Black can collect his partner to loot the coin inside.
[/list]
[b]Little Bro[/b]
[list][b]Roller Drift[/b]
[*]He can stun characters in contact when he is accelerated after dash.
[/list]
[b]O. Deer[/b]
[list][b]Double Heart[/b]
[*]Skill remake with only single charge. 
[*]Additional short dash can be casted at the end of dash, maximum two times.
[/list]
[b]KOI[/b]
[list][b]BunShinJutsu[/b]
[*]He will also cast the area knock back again when he blink back to his clone.
[/list]
[b]Father[/b]
[list][b]God's Hug[/b]
[*]He will slow down characters attracted for longer period.
[/list]


[b]System[/b]
Related changes to enhance the experience.

[list][b]Select Screen[/b]
[*]Breaker Select shows skill description, make it clear before your pick. 
[/list]
[list][b]Loading Screen[/b]
[*]New Loading Screen with simple tutorial are applied on gameplay, make the rule clear before the start! 
[/list]
[list][b]Gameplay[/b]
[*]Visual updates on several maps and effects, try not to hurt everyone's eyeball.
[*]Camera movement adjustment on gameplay, help you not to get lost of your character.
[/list]
[list][b]Result[/b]
[*]Player's Attack and Coin Collected score are now showing correctly, we have fixed our broken calculator.
[/list]
[list][b]Menu[/b]
[*]Added Patch Note button and panel, read me in the game <3
[/list]

notes.title: v0.6.0 - Triple Rumble Battle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35484557/471958954e6668535622b4930d7a7c7e7ce3940f.jpg[/img]
Triple Rumble Battle
Massive changes in existing maps and bosses, with addition of new Rumble Arena maps.
Come and join the Triple Rumble Battle! 



[b]version 0.6.0
release date: 31/08/2020[/b]



[b]Arena and Maps[/b]
Concept and details for all maps have been adjusted to enhance the game play.


[b]Team Battle[/b]
To emphasize the core game play of boss domination and co-operation for each team, bosses in all Team Battle maps received game play changes.
The break down period of Bosses has been temporary removed.

[b]Meow Meow Head Quarter[/b]
Meow Meow Head Quarter is a map focusing on kiting Meow Machine to attack opponent's ship.
[list][b]Meow Machine[/b]
[*] His Ultimate Smash is much quicker than before.
[/list]

[b]Echo Valley[/b]
Echo Valley is now focusing on controlling the mark of gaze from BaT-T to attack opponent's ship.
[list][b]BaT-T[/b]
[*] She will perform Dive attack when the mark of gaze is completed counting. (it lasts 5 seconds)
[*] Her Ultimate Phantom Dive comes with more variation, get your body moving!
[/list]

[b]Golden Pipework[/b]
Golden Pipework is a map requires players to adjust and bait the missiles shot by Carb3.
[list][b]Crab3[/b]
[*] He is now keep patrolling around in the map.
[*] He shoots missiles more often than before.
[*] His missile is chasing the player with marks and can be blocked by all other obstacle including players.
[/list]


[b]Rumble Arena[/b]
All rumble arena maps are having a different mechanics for specific game play style.

[b]Crystal Stadium[/b]
Crystal Stadium is reworked as a stage capturing map.
[list][*] The stage in the middle is now rotating and can only be accessed by the stairs on two sides.
[*] Golden slime statues will reward the only player who can stand on the stage alone.
[/list]

[b]Ancient Archive[/b]
Ancient Archive is a bigger arena requires map awareness and path planning.
[list][*] Bonus coins are spawned in one of the six tunnels randomly, be aware of it!
[*] Characters dropping into the magma gap will instantly die and drop all the coins.
[/list]

[b]Downtown[/b]
Downtown is an arena locating in the busy crossroads, cars and coins are coming in a chaotic way.
[list][*] Cars driving through the arena are spawning randomly from all directions.
[*] Player will lose their coins when they get hit by the cars, be a safe passengers!
[/list]

[b]Plasma Cavern[/b]
Plasma Cavern is a safe area for players to collect coins, apart from the deadly plasma.
[list][*] Deadly plasma is dripped into the arena and slowly disappear periodically.
[*] Players got hit into the plasma will lose their coins rapidly! Get rid of it!!!!
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][b]Emoji system[/b]
[*]Emoji system is added into game play scenes.
[*]Players playing with controllers can press D-Pad to show emotions.
[/list]
[b]System[/b]
The flow of starting a game has been changed. 
Players need to enter a lobby before starting their new games.

[list][b]Lobby Screen[/b]
[*]Lobby Screen has been added into the game for controller recognising and win records.
[*]Reselect in pause panel will now redirect to Lobby Screen.
[/list]
[list][b]Select Screen[/b]
[*]Select Screen has been remade for showing more information. 
[*]COM can be added when players are selecting their Breakers.
[/list]
[list][b]General[/b]
[*]Bug fixes on all menu.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.5.0 - Power Party Up
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35484557/48676bb8e1f342a57688153b75a8ff7fd7d64018.jpg[/img]

Power Party Up
New Breakers and Game Modes arrived Balance Breakers to power up the party!
Stay safe at home and play with friends on Remote Play!


[b]version 0.5.0
release date: 08/06/2020[/b]



[b]New Breaker[/b]

[b]Father[/b]

The holy big guy from "Balance" has arrived the arena, giving hug to all Breakers!
[list][b]God's Hug[/b]
[*]His dash will attract nearby people, be loved or be afraid?
[/list]


[b]Special Coins[/b]

Two special coins have been added into the treasury, spawned randomly through out the game.
[list][b]Rainbow Coin[/b]
[*]Once triggered, rainbow chests will appear in a circle and shooting 7 coins towards the centre after a short delay.
[b]Darkness Coin[/b]
[*]Once triggered, a darkness orb will explode after a delay and everyone pass through the area will drop half of their treasure bag.
[/list]


[b]Power Gems[/b]

Power Gem gives special power to whom collect and consume it.
They will appear randomly in special modes and rumble arena!
[list][b]Ace Gem[/b]
[*]Once consumed, player gains extra movement speed and become immune and able to kick off others by collision.
[b]Abyssal Gem[/b]
[*]Once consumed, an abyssal spawns around player and hit off other players treasure.
[b]Blast Gem[/b]
[*]Once consumed, three hurricane spawns and move around players, they can blow up other players.
[b]Explosion Gem[/b]
[*]Once consumed, player shoot four fireballs in cross direction to stun other players. 
[/list]


[b]Game Mode[/b]

To add more fun to the party, try out the new Game Modes and play in a brand new way!
[list][b]One Punch[/b]
[*]Ignore dash and other attacks, use the punch attack to knock off others effectively!
[/list]
[list][b]Fast Forward[/b]
[*]Players have faster movement speed and cool downs, also the treasure spawned are increased.
[/list]
[list][b]Treasure Room[/b]
[*]Power Gems spawn in all maps, also Special Coins spawns much more frequently.
[/list]
[list][b]Chess[/b]
[*]Players have to rely on their dash to move and attack, play strategically!
[/list]

[b]Maps[/b]
[list][b]Meow Meow Head Quarter[/b]
[*]B.C.M's Ultimate Smash is much quicker now, be aware of the quicker pace!
[*]The targeted eye has been adjusted to chase the richest person every time B.C.M. reset.
[/list]

[b]New game selecting method[/b]
[list][b]Quick Match[/b]
[*]A quick way for selecting random game setting, just choose your team and breaker. 
[/list]
[list][b]Team Setting: Team Battle / Rumble Arena[/b]
[*]Team Battle: Classic setting for team battle
[*]Rumble Arena: Simple setting for every players to fight on their own
[/list]
[list][b]Mode Setting: Classic / Party[/b]
[*]Classic: basic mode of Balance Breakers
[*]Party: special modes are available to be selected
[/list]

[b]System[/b]
[list][b]Select Screen[/b]
[*]Select Bar has been added to Select Screen for information and quick swap to previous pages.
[*]Mode Select page is added for all party mode.
[/list]
[list][b]Control method changes[/b]
[*]Team Select has now changed into "Press to join" method.
[*]Control setting has been removed on Menu.
[/list]
[list][b]General[/b]
[*]Bug fixes on all Menu and UI selection, to make it more responsive to controllers.

notes.title: Control Methods Update: Play it easier!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35484557/782da75a43a59527a584dd52acfdbbf7a11f2532.jpg[/img]

To let more players can enjoy Balance Breakers and play together easily, 
there are several features focusing on the accessibility in version 0.4.


[h3]Keyboard Support[/h3]
P1 and P2 can use keyboard as their controllers to get into the fight.
P3 and P4 still have to be activated with controllers, please get your gamepad for 4 players party!
(We have tested the controller with general controllers like PS4, XBOX and Switch, all of them work excellent in the game. Please let us know if any of your controller suffers and we will fix it asap.)

[h3]AI Bots[/h3]
We know that players want to try the game before party.
There is always some embarrassing moments that you don't have enough players to separate as two teams.
AI Bots are ready to join any teams, you can start your game even if you just want to have self-training with your beloved character.


Your voices are heard and we will keep on updating Balance Breakers!
Please let us know your comments and let's make the game better together!

notes.title: Version 0.3 Controller Issues
notes.content:
We have received several reports on the issues of controllers.
We would like to apologise for the inconvenience and explain more about the input system in the current version.

At the moment, Balance Breakers only supports to be played with controllers.
The Keyboard and Mouse support is only available for menu and pause panel.

From version 0.3.0, there are serious bugs on the newly updated input system. 
We have fixed it in version 0.3.2 and the controllers will no longer disconnect and recognised in wrong orders.

The best experience to enjoy Balance Breakers is surely having 4 players fighting in the arena.
We encourage players can try our game with more players to fully enjoy the game.
To make it easier to be played with more players, keyboard inputs for 1 and 2 players will be added in the next update coming very soon.

Stay tuned for the next update and please keep on supporting our development!
